name: Blue Gold
summary: At Valormok, Izvi Gildfizz wants a Mana-Siphoning Wand from the blood elf arcanists. She hopes to profit from the scramble for ancient Highborne magic.

sections.title: A Seller's Market
sections.body: Izvi Gildfizz at Valormok sees a chance to profit from the search for ancient Highborne magic. Belgrom, the elves, and the naga all want a share, but she asks you to bring her a Mana-Siphoning Wand carried by blood elf arcanists. Their camp lies east of the elves' base camp, along the cliffs.

faq.answer: Izvi Gildfizz asks you to bring her a Mana-Siphoning Wand carried by blood elf arcanists.

faq.q: Why does Izvi want the wand?
faq.answer: Izvi believes she can profit from the interest in ancient Highborne magic.

faq.q: Who is looking for Highborne magic?
faq.answer: Belgrom, the elves, and the naga are all seeking a share of ancient Highborne magic.

faq.q: What are the wands used for?
faq.answer: Blood elf arcanists use the special wands to draw magical energy from artifacts the elves find.
Their camp is east of the elves' base camp, along the cliffs.
